(medium tempo swing)

It happens that under the influence of various factors we are not able to control our emotions, which can sometimes cause harm to our loved ones.

(medium fast bossanova)

I remember the Black Sea, its relatively recent calm and serenity, the gentle lapping of the waves, the bright sun and the beautiful light of the moon.

(fast jazz waltz)

Our life is often like an obstacle course where we need to rhythmically overcome difficulties, and each time it seems that it becomes more and more difficult.

(medium fast bossa nova)

Huge beautiful snowflakes float across the city, filling it with sparkling whiteness; here and there white carpets can already be seen.
